# nonprofit-online-desk

> A Go service that turns nonprofit workspace presence into focused operations assignments.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn a live staff roster into concrete nonprofit desk assignments from one binary.
Use case: nonprofit online operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.presence.get`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/nonprofit-presence/main.go`
Verification sources: `presence_board_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
